verdict.rationale: Cline runs a hosted provider gateway (api.cline.bot) and account sign-in, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair question for this product. The evidence only shows bring-your-own provider keys and a single sign-in with Cline credits. There is no documented way to mint scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API credentials. Auto Approve's per-action permissions limit what the agent may do, not what a credential can access, so they are an adjacent control and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
